text: The doctor saw him in a short session at noon.
translation: 医生在中午给他看了短短一节课时间。
note: 一段有限的时间 = 期间

text: Our talk was a long session before the exam.
translation: 考试前我们谈了很久。
note: 一次谈时间的场合 = 期间

text: After one more session the pain was gone.
translation: 再做一次治疗疼痛就消失了。
note: 一次治疗时段 = 期间

text: It took two sessions to fix the broken leg.
translation: 治好这条断腿花了两次治疗。
note: 多次治疗时段 = 期间

text: During that session nobody spoke a word.
translation: 那段时间里没人说一句话。

text: The court will hold its session next Monday.
translation: 法院下周一开庭。
note: 法庭的开庭期 = 开庭期

text: He was questioned in a long court session.
translation: 他在一次漫长的庭审中被审问。

text: The judge ended the session before six o'clock.
translation: 法官在六点前结束了开庭。

text: She sat through the whole court session quietly.
translation: 她安静地坐完了整个庭审。

text: His case will not come to session this year.
translation: 他的案子今年不会开庭。

text: Everyone at the last session voted for her.
translation: 上次会上所有人都投了她一票。

text: The final session runs from nine to five.
translation: 最后一次会议从九点开到五点。

text: He spoke for five minutes in that session.
translation: 他在那次会上讲了五分钟。

text: The morning session was short but useful.
translation: 上午那场会议虽短但有用。
note: 分场次的会议 = 会议

text: We need one more session to settle it.
translation: 我们还需要一次会议才能定下来。

text: This term has been the hardest session of my life.
translation: 这个学期是我一生中最难的一学期。
note: 一学期的教学期 = 学期

text: She failed her final session at the college.
translation: 她大学最后一学期挂科了。

text: He came back for the winter session only.
translation: 他只为冬季学期回来了。

text: That was easy compared with this session.
translation: 和这个学期比那 easy 算轻松了。

text: I will study English in every session.
translation: 我每个学期都会学英语。
